LanguageData.TSX_IncludeArchiteDesc: Allow traders to sell xenogerms for xenotypes containing archite genes (e.g., Sanguophage). These are typically more expensive.
LanguageData.TSX_IncludeInheritableDesc: Allow traders to sell xenogerms for germline xenotypes (e.g., Impid, Yttakin). Implanting these creates 'naturalized' members recognized by ideology.
LanguageData.TSX_IncludePlayerCreatedDesc: Allow traders to sell xenogerms for xenotypes you created in the scenario editor. Disabled by default since traders wouldn't logically have access to your custom designs.
LanguageData.TSX_PricingSectionDesc: Adjust the market value formula for trader-sold xenogerms. Changes affect new xenogerms only.
LanguageData.TSX_BasePresetValueDesc: Base silver value added to all preset xenotype xenogerms. Default: {0}
LanguageData.TSX_ValuePerMetabolismDesc: Silver value added per point of absolute metabolism. Default: {0}
LanguageData.TSX_ValuePerComplexityDesc: Silver value added per point of genetic complexity. Default: {0}
LanguageData.TSX_ValuePerArchiteDesc: Silver value added per archite gene. Default: {0}
